principle: Store city-owned facts by city; retrieve by the decision the traveller is trying to make.

layers.purpose: Choose a city or city pair before loading detailed city records.

layers.scope: one selected city or product unit
layers.purpose: Resolve pace, route, deletion and hidden-need questions.
Fill the route only after the route question is known.
Apply the same safety, evidence and delivery rules across cities.

retrieval_modes.city_focused: Named city detected; filter detailed records by its destination slug.
retrieval_modes.comparison: Two or more named cities, or an explicit choice question; load only comparison and decision records for candidates.
retrieval_modes.portfolio_discovery: No city named; search small portfolio summaries and interaction overlays first, then promote at most three candidates.
retrieval_modes.research_only: Private access, medical/safety, booking or other guarded request; retrieve boundaries and human-review tasks before any route details.

never_do: retrieve every city detail record for a single-city request
mix cities without a comparison reason
treat source_note as current operational fact
promote a private-access lead to a route promise
